FFmpeg redistribution notice (VoiceStudio bundled ffmpeg/ffprobe)
================================================================

VoiceStudio ships ffmpeg.exe and ffprobe.exe in its install directory
(bin/). We use a LGPL-licensed FFmpeg build (configured with --enable-lgpl;
libmp3lame included under LGPL). We do NOT ship a GPL build.

Source code and build configuration for the exact build we ship are
obtained from the FFmpeg project (https://ffmpeg.org). The FFmpeg source
is available to you under LGPL-2.1-or-later; you may obtain a copy of the
license text from the FFmpeg source distribution or https://ffmpeg.org/legal.html.

FFmpeg is a trademark of Fabrice Bellard, originator of the FFmpeg project.

This application is not affiliated with or endorsed by the FFmpeg project.
